changeReason: Pre-observation clarification: define which forward annual fiscal period supplies the primary cross-sectional signal. No PIT estimate snapshots had been collected before this clarification.

hypothesis.primary: Stocks whose forward fundamental estimates improve faster than their prices subsequently outperform.
hypothesis.mechanism: Fundamental information may diffuse into analyst estimates and market prices at different speeds.
hypothesis.multibaggerExtension: Persistent positive estimate-price divergence may identify firms undergoing structural reacceleration before full price discovery.

signalFiscalSelector.definition: For each snapshot, sort annual fiscal periods with periodEnd strictly after snapshotDate. The nearest future period is F1, the next is F2. Revision history always matches the exact same periodEnd; prior F2 observations may become later F1 observations without splicing different fiscal periods.
